insights.one_liner: Consulting firm in Esch for larger family businesses in retail, wholesale, food and manufacturing; senior roles, often with pay shown.

culture.text: Advises larger entrepreneurial and family businesses, combining strategy and processes with management and change management, with a pragmatic, results-focused approach.
All 3 current jobs here are mid and senior consulting roles in Esch.

open.text: Not an IND recognised visa sponsor, so non-EU candidates may struggle to get a work visa.
2 of its 3 current jobs here don't require Dutch, and 2 of 3 show pay.

growth.text: Recently hired Max Boeren as a Business Associate.
